clips.title: The story
paras: Travelers gather at the Lion's Pride Inn, Goldshire's tavern and community center in Elwynn Forest. Innkeeper Farley keeps the inn, a place to rest, meet others, and find work just south of Stormwind City.

The Lion's Pride Inn anchors Goldshire at the crossroads of Elwynn Forest. Innkeeper Farley keeps it by the old motto, “Rest and relaxation for the tired and cold.” Inside, warm hearths, strong drinks, and rooms welcome weary travelers from Northshire. Goldshire sits on trade routes between Stormwind, Westfall, Redridge, and Duskwood, making the inn an indispensable gathering place. Town marshals, local crafters, and seasoned trainers meet there to share news and hire passing mercenaries.
